parsed.summary: The netlist matches the specification's architecture in all checked details: 24V input path (H13→FB2→F2→TVS D5→P-FET reverse-polarity switch T1/D2/R49), TPS62933 buck (SW→L2→+5V, FB divider R22 52.3k/R48 10k giving ≈5.0 V, BST C70, SS C95, RT R38), AZ1117 LDO pinout, two ADM3260 isolated I2C channels with correct V_ISO/VDD_ISO/GND_ISO domains and 2.2 k isolated pull-ups, unisolated EZO-RTD on the main I2C bus (2.2 k pull-ups R10/R55), three TMC2209 drivers with 110 mΩ sense pairs, VREF dividers, shared UART on IO21/IO22 and STEP lines on IO15/IO19/IO11 exactly as the spec's pin table states, and float interlocks (R3/R5 pulls, R23/R26 base resistors) with the pump-gate 10 k pull-up (R11) and valve-gate 10 k pull-down (R8) both consistent with the spec's described low-level-cutoff / high-level-overflow behavior. No component value, footprint, or connectivity deviation from the intended design is supported by the files.
